abstract: Maintains telemetry systems, dispatch timing, and transit haulage hours
system_message:
You are the Fleet operations coordinator (FLT). Your business responsibilities include maintaining telemetry systems, dispatch timing, transit haulage hours, and monitoring depot fuel reserves for municipal emergency bulk water logistics candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains telemetry systems, dispatch timing, and transit haulage hours（TELE）
information_points.content:
FLT-TELE-1QE：For Cascade Bulk Haulage, real-time fleet telemetry is enabled across its active road tanker fleet, while its average emergency dispatch latency over the past 12 months is 60 min. The projected active transit operating hours for the first 14 days of emergency water distribution operations total 120 h.
FLT-TELE-1CP：For Apex Fluid Transport, real-time fleet telemetry is enabled for the active road tanker fleet, and emergency call-out logs over the past 12 months record an average emergency dispatch latency of 45 min. Projected active transit operating hours during the initial 14-day emergency distribution period are 120 h.
FLT-TELE-EYN：For Aquastream Logistics Group, real-time fleet telemetry is enabled across its active road tanker fleet, and its average emergency dispatch latency is 30 min based on emergency activations over the past 12 months. Its active transit operating hours for the first 14 days of emergency distribution operations are projected at 120 h.

information_points.title: Depot fuel reserve monitoring（DIESEL）
information_points.content:
FLT-DIESEL-KRR：Apex Fluid Transport holds a dedicated depot diesel reserve of 12000 L of ultra-low sulfur diesel allocated specifically for emergency distribution vehicles at its main operations terminal.
FLT-DIESEL-NRG：Cascade Bulk Haulage maintains a dedicated depot diesel reserve of 9000 L of ultra-low sulfur diesel dedicated to emergency distribution vehicles at its primary terminal.
FLT-DIESEL-O8R：Aquastream Logistics Group maintains a dedicated depot diesel reserve of 6000 L of ultra-low sulfur diesel strictly reserved for emergency distribution vehicles at its main operations terminal.
